pressers.title: 2020 Week 1
pressers.body:
Tier 1 - Fully Fucking Torqued

1.  Chula Vista

Boobie Miles Sanders was out Week 1, but Murray, Hopkins, and Theilen look to be in top form this year.  The Double D's DJ and DMont didn't look too shabby either.  Must've borrowed an Astronomy book about from the Warlords, because this roster has Stars and Depth.  Look for the Chupacabras to do ATLEAST this good, every week, going forward.

Random Roster Nugget (RRN):

Mrs. Chup has strategically added a couple pounds in preparation of birthing a baby, and it seems the Chups have grown quite fond of this body type as they trade for Algiers Jameal Dillon Jr., and his fat ass is now headed to Chula Vista.

1.  Squaw Valley

The Skinners are in need of a bounce back year for the first time since 2015, when they won their first championship.  Jacobs n Carson helped the cause by Peacefully Penising the Privileged Gringos Week 1.

RRN: With Lawrence Burton III on IR, John Glenn Doyle was poised for a huge game but disappointed.  Denniston Moore Jr. also ceded to Spaghetti Boy

1.  Fairview

7 of 9 of the Fat Cats starting lineup hit Double Didgees, Helping The Round Meows strut into the Week 1 Triple Didgee Club.  Kittens have great nocturnal vision, but they didn't shy away from the bright lights performing very well in Primetime with CEH and Fant and ultimately Clawing the Cuck all week long.

RRN: Will Rayne Dakota Prescott head to the bench? Stay tuned.

1.  San Diego

The Dicks from the Dark out shafted the Snakes rather easily Week 1.  The Studs performed up to expectations, and it looks like the Cocks are filling out the rest of their roster adequately.

RRN: DeKaylin Zecharius Metcalf redeemed his drop with a tud, and this dude is a stud.

Tier 2 - Not ideal, but plenty of appeal

1.  Tittsburgh

The Tittsburgh Ravens, err uhh, Feelers were prepared for the Horndogs this year and came out on top.  The Feelers won the MoW, but the Feeling went from

on Monday where 89 of his Dollars went for 10.5 points.

RRN: Darrell Demont Chark Jr. just doesn't have the same ring to it.

1.  Westeros

The Warlords were scouting in Chula Vista during the draft, and returned for Week 1 to get generously pounded in the ass.  This loss hurts, but the promising points will keep Westeros Lourdes of their own cumposure…..for a time.

Tier 3 - The biggest room in the world, is the room for Improvement

1.  Muck City

The Champs started off the 2020 season on the right paw with a win right out of the kennel.  Big Dawgs don't like little dogs, so they Tore Tijuana a new asshole.

RRN: Quintorris Lopez Jones is still awesome Eugene Marquis Hilton is not.

1.  Goleta

GRRRIIIINNNGRRRIGRING….grirningnir….gug..gug (battery dies).

RRN: J'Kaylin Dobbins wasn't joking about being good at football.

1.  Honolulu

The Erotically Charged Canines ushering Aaron Rodgers to his bench Hurt so much it made the Bitching Bitch Squirt.

Dominique Raheem Mostert will go by Colonel D.R. Mostert from now on.

1.  Winston-Salem

A very quiet week by a very quiet Snake.

RRN: Silence of the Cederian Lamb

Tears - Hello darkness my old friend, I've come to talk with you again

1.  Tijuana

Holy Fucking Horrible Batman! 2 players on the entire roster scored Double Didgees…..They are both Quarterbacks.  It's easy to realize you fucked up big time when you're relying on the TNF Browns vs Bengals in Week 2.

RRN: O'Terrius Jabari Howard ended up being the Bucs TE to own.

1.  DC

Sitting players and scoring less than 69 points has this Cuck not even allowed to Watch his Wife.

RRN: Rod Christopher Godwin (RodGod) will turn it around and lead the Cucks to Salvation. Lol JK.

pressers.title: 2020 Week 2
pressers.body:
Tier 1 - Fully Fucking Torqued

RRN: It looks like Stefon is trying to Digg his way into the starting lineup

StreamGod got 13 more points from a waiver wire QB, having us all question why we drafted a QB in the first place.  All starters besides the negative D (AKA inverted penis) and Kicker scored Double Didgee, that and a lil prick in the knee to his Saquon Voodoo Barkley doll was all that was needed to Skin the Feelers for the 13th time in a row.

Tier 2 - Not ideal, but plenty of appeal

Is Aaron Jones the new RB1 overall?  Is Aaron Rodgers Revenge Tour just beginning?  The Horndogs bet on the Fudge Packers, and it's working Faggots!

Losing Barkley lost the Feelers the week, and probably the Season.  All hope is lost.

Just doesn't seem like a good year for White People.

Sanchitos for the Win!  The whole league was rooting for the Poor Unhealthy Mexican's (PUMs) in this one.  Year after year they get fucked by injuries, but there is no quit in this hourly worker.

RRN: Chubb, Cox, and Lazard are all great names to call your dick.

Tier 4 - Bleak

1.  Winston-Salem Wake Snakes

The benching of Scary Terry costed the Wake Snakes a W.  The GM just didn't draft the type of team that usually covers the ineptitude of the Winston-Salem Coach.

1.  DC

The reason you're so bad is the same reason Skinners are so good.  As much as you hate yourself, remember, we hate you more.

RRN:  You are a fucking faggot.
